# Waypoint — instructions for LLMs and coding agents

> Prefer this file + AGENTS.md over scraping the whole repo.
> Live (same-origin): /llms.txt and /llm.txt on the public demo host.

## What this is

Waypoint is a **travel-readiness concierge** for the Amazon Developer Hackathon 2026 (Alexa+ track).
Self-hosted MCP server (2025-11-25, Streamable HTTP) + simulated Alexa+ host (real MCP client in the browser).
Not affiliated with Amazon; does not connect to production Alexa+.

## Primary path — public web (judges on a phone)

Live demo:
https://hwbs7pqoqtsbcgb72stpikb5gy0scxmv.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/

1. Open that URL on a phone or laptop (no install).
2. Switch UI language to EN, then tap **Example group** (☰ menu on small screens).
3. Ask: "Can I bring vapes to Singapore?"
4. Ask: "Going to Japan 3–10 December"
5. Optional: "Get me ready for the trip" (Autopilot)

Judge-facing documentation is English-only (README, AGENTS.md, docs/).

Health: GET .../healthz  → protocolVersion "2025-11-25", brain may be true on deploy.

## Client security — HARD RULE

The browser MUST only call **same-origin** public paths:
- /mcp
- /api/brain   (server runs Bedrock; browser never gets AWS keys)
- /api/speech  (server runs Polly)
- /healthz
- /llms.txt , /llm.txt
- static /web assets

FORBIDDEN in the public demo / any client bundle:
- NEXT_PUBLIC_* , EXPO_PUBLIC_* , VITE_* , or any env that embeds secrets
- AWS keys, Bedrock model ids as client config, Alexa refresh tokens
- Private VPC URLs, admin URLs, or second backends exposed to the page

Secrets and cloud SDKs stay on Lambda / GitHub Actions (OIDC). Treat the Function URL as a demo surface, not a vault.

## Optional local run

```bash
npm install          # Node >= 22
npm start            # http://127.0.0.1:3000
WAYPOINT_OFFLINE=1 npm start
```

## Knowledge scale (why this is not a thin wrapper)

| Dataset | Scale |
|--------|------:|
| Passport×destination matrix | ~39,600 rows |
| Quote-checked country packs | 13 |
| Curated places | 194 countries · 14,115 places |
| Ranked place fallbacks | 182 countries |
| Travel guides | 72 countries |
| Payment methods | 197 countries |
| What-works-without-card | 195 countries |
| Transit country notes | 174 · + 13 named metro systems |
| Gazetteer | 197 countries · 1,698 cities |

Full tool×knowledge tables: README.md § "Knowledge scale" and § "MCP tools (26) — full catalog".

## MCP tools (26 names — schemas in src/tools.ts)

get_traveler_profile, update_traveler_profile, forget_me,
plan_trip, check_entry_requirements, get_local_rules, get_destination_essentials,
get_travel_guide, get_trip_calendar,
convert_budget, get_payment_methods, get_what_works, get_local_apps, get_transit_payment,
log_expense, settle_up,
get_trip_climate, packing_checklist, get_highlights, set_trip_constraints,
build_itinerary, trip_brief, plan_fairness,
add_booking, confirm_booking, export_trip

Envelope: voice, card, data, sources[], lastVerified, confidence, disclaimer, followUps[].

## Invariants

- Do not invent visa/rules; call tools / packs.
- Do not claim Amazon affiliation or live Alexa+.
- agent-skills/waypoint/SKILL.md is NOT an Alexa Agent Skill.
- Never commit .env, private keys, ASK_REFRESH_TOKEN values, AWS secret values.
- Do not add client-side env that leaks private services.
